name: Druidcraft
description: Transmutation cantrip, Druid access only. Action, 30 feet, V/S, instantaneous, no save or attack. Choose one harmless effect: Tiny sensory prediction of local weather for the next 24 hours (one-round display); instantly bloom a flower/open a seed pod or leaf bud; harmless sensory effect within a five-foot Cube (falling leaves, breeze or faint animal sound); instantly light or extinguish a candle, torch or small campfire. No damage, healing or scaling. GM supplies weather and fictional details.
